text: {"lessons":["My account has declined overall despite a profitable sale, so I should assess the whole portfolio rather than treat one gain as proof of success.","Selling Stock B above my average cost felt rewarding, but I should not sell merely to lock in gains or hold merely to avoid admitting a mistake.","With no reliable predictive signal in past price moves, I should make deliberate decisions based on my plan instead of reacting to monthly fluctuations."]}
